transcript.en: Hello English learners and welcome back to EnglishPod.
transcript.zh: 大家好，英语学习者们，欢迎回到 EnglishPod。

transcript.en: Marco, I'm doing really well today.
We've got a great lesson for everyone.
transcript.zh: 我们为大家准备了一节很棒的课。

transcript.en: Yes, we have a really common situation where we're going to use real English, right?
transcript.zh: 是的，我们有一个非常常见的场景，我们会用到地道的英语，对吧？

transcript.en: Yep, everyday English, English that people really use.
transcript.zh: 是的，日常英语，人们真正在用的英语。

transcript.en: And that's what we want you to learn.
transcript.zh: 这就是我们想让你学到的。

transcript.en: What are we talking about today specifically?
transcript.zh: 我们今天具体要聊什么？

transcript.en: Today we have a really common situation that is a little bit embarrassing.
transcript.zh: 今天我们有一个非常常见但又有点尴尬的场景。

transcript.en: So let's listen to the dialogue for the first time and it's going to be kind of fast.
transcript.zh: 那么，我们来听第一遍对话，语速会有点快。

transcript.en: Yeah, but don't worry if you don't understand everything because after 10 minutes you'll understand everything.
transcript.zh: 是的，但如果不能全部听懂也别担心，因为十分钟后你就会全部理解了。

transcript.en: What are you doing in this neighbourhood?
Actually, my office is right around the corner.
transcript.zh: 其实，我的办公室就在拐角处。

transcript.en: It was great to meet you last week at the conference.
transcript.zh: 上周在会议上认识你真是太高兴了。

transcript.en: I really enjoyed our conversation about foreign investment.
transcript.zh: 我真的很享受我们关于外国投资的讨论。

transcript.en: Yeah, yeah, it was really interesting.
transcript.zh: 是啊是啊，确实很有意思。

transcript.en: You know, I'm in a bit of a hurry, but here's my card.
transcript.zh: 是这样，我有点赶时间，不过这是我的名片。

transcript.en: We should definitely meet up again and continue our discussion.
transcript.zh: 我们一定要找时间再聚聚，继续我们的讨论。

transcript.en: Sure, you still have my contact details, right?
transcript.zh: 当然，你还有我的联系方式，对吧？

transcript.en: You know what, this is really embarrassing, but your name has just slipped my mind.
transcript.zh: 说来挺尴尬的，但我突然想不起你的名字了。

transcript.en: Sure, my name is Ana Ferris.
Don't worry about it, it happens to me all the time.
transcript.zh: 别担心，这种事经常发生在我身上。

transcript.en: Yeah, that's happened to me a couple of times, and I'm going to tell you about it a little bit later.
transcript.zh: 是啊，我也遇到过几次，我稍后会跟你聊这个。

transcript.en: All right, well, let's start with our three language takeaways.
transcript.zh: 好的，嗯，我们开始讲今天的三个语言要点。

transcript.en: So our first word on our language takeaway is in a bit of a hurry.
transcript.zh: 我们语言要点的第一个词是 in a bit of a hurry（有点赶时间）。

transcript.en: In a bit of a hurry.
transcript.zh: In a bit of a hurry。

transcript.en: In a bit of a hurry.
transcript.zh: In a bit of a hurry。

transcript.en: In a bit of a hurry.
transcript.zh: In a bit of a hurry。

transcript.en: So Nick was in a hurry.
So let's listen to three examples of how you can use this phrase.
transcript.zh: 那么我们来听三个例子，看看如何使用这个短语。

transcript.en: I'm in a bit of a hurry.
I'm in a bit of a hurry.
I'm in a bit of a hurry, so I'll check these files later.
transcript.zh: 我有点赶时间，这些文件我稍后再看。

transcript.en: Basically it means that you don't have time.
transcript.zh: 基本上意思是你没有时间。

transcript.en: Now let's look at our second language takeaway word, and it's contact details.
transcript.zh: 现在我们来看第二个语言要点词，contact details（联系方式）。

transcript.en: So what are your contact details?
transcript.zh: 那么什么是你的 contact details？

transcript.en: Basically, this is the information you can find on your business card.
transcript.zh: 基本上，这就是你在名片上能找到的信息。

transcript.en: All right, so we have like our name, our telephone number.
transcript.zh: 好的，比如我们有姓名、电话号码。

transcript.en: Your email address, perhaps your mobile phone number.
transcript.zh: 你的邮箱地址，也许还有手机号码。

transcript.en: So all the useful information so people can get in touch with you.
transcript.zh: 所有这些有用的信息，方便别人联系到你。

transcript.en: Yeah, so people can phone you or email you.
transcript.zh: 是的，这样人们就可以给你打电话或发邮件。

transcript.en: Okay, so our third word is slipped my mind.
transcript.zh: 好的，我们的第三个词是 slipped my mind（我一时想不起来了）。

transcript.en: So this is a funny phrase.
Okay, so now we're going to listen to two examples of this phrase.
transcript.zh: 好的，现在我们要听两个关于这个短语的例子。

transcript.en: Try and see if you can figure out what it means.
transcript.zh: 试着看看你能不能猜出它的意思。

transcript.en: I'm sorry I forgot to respond to your email.
transcript.zh: 对不起我忘了回复你的邮件。

transcript.en: Don't you know what day it is today?
transcript.zh: 你不知道今天是什么日子吗？

transcript.en: Ah, so slipped my mind is like I forgot.
transcript.zh: 啊，所以 slipped my mind 就像说 I forgot。

transcript.en: Now it's time for putting it together.
transcript.zh: 现在到了「融会贯通」的时间。

transcript.en: All right, Erika, why don't you tell our listeners what putting it together is?
transcript.zh: 好的，艾瑞卡，你来告诉我们的听众什么是融会贯通？

transcript.en: Well, putting it together helps you put language together.
transcript.zh: 嗯，融会贯通帮助你组合语言。

transcript.en: It helps you be more fluent by knowing how words fit together.
transcript.zh: 通过了解单词如何搭配，帮助你更流利。

transcript.en: So let's look at our first phrase today.
transcript.zh: 那么我们来看今天的第一个短语。

transcript.en: So this is like close by.
transcript.zh: 所以这就像是 close by（附近）。

transcript.en: We can say, for example, is there a bank around here?
transcript.zh: 我们可以说，例如，这附近有银行吗？

transcript.en: So that's, is there a bank close to here?
transcript.zh: 那就是，这附近有银行吗？

transcript.en: Now, this phrase, around here, we can change it a little bit and it means something a little bit different.
transcript.zh: 现在，这个短语 around here，我们可以稍微改变一下，意思就有点不同了。

transcript.en: I could say, Marco, there's a great restaurant right around the corner.
transcript.zh: 我可以说，马可，拐角处有一家很棒的餐厅。

transcript.en: And that would mean there is a great restaurant on the other street.
transcript.zh: 那意思是，在另一条街上有一家很棒的餐厅。

transcript.en: And another example, we can say around there.
transcript.zh: 另一个例子，我们可以说 around there（那附近）。

transcript.en: So, for example, I can say, Los Angeles is a great city.
transcript.zh: 那么，例如，我可以说，洛杉矶是一个很棒的城市。

transcript.en: I used to live around there.
So you used to live near Los Angeles.
transcript.zh: 所以你以前住在洛杉矶附近。

transcript.en: It's a really good phrase and it's really common.
transcript.zh: 这是一个非常好的短语，非常常见。

transcript.en: Now, our next phrase in putting it together is terrible with.
transcript.zh: 现在，我们融会贯通的下一个短语是 terrible with（对……很不在行）。

transcript.en: And I have a couple of examples that will show you how this phrase works.
transcript.zh: 我有几个例子来展示这个短语的用法。

transcript.en: You can't even remember your own telephone number.
transcript.zh: 你连自己的电话号码都记不住。

transcript.en: I can never remember what people look like.
transcript.zh: 我总是不记得别人长什么样。

transcript.en: I can barely add two plus two.
transcript.zh: 我几乎连二加二都算不出来。

transcript.en: Well, yeah, I guess not everyone is a numbers person.
transcript.zh: 嗯，是啊，我想不是每个人都是数字型的人。

transcript.en: I sometimes forget what people look like.
transcript.zh: 我有时会忘记别人长什么样。

transcript.en: I think it's time for us to listen to our dialogue a second time.
transcript.zh: 我想我们该听第二遍对话了。

transcript.en: OK, this time the dialogue will be a little bit slower.
transcript.zh: 好的，这次对话会稍微慢一点。

transcript.en: So try and listen for some of the words we've just talked about.
transcript.zh: 所以试着听出我们刚才讲的一些词汇。

transcript.en: What are you doing in this neighbourhood?
Actually, my office is right around the corner.
transcript.zh: 其实，我的办公室就在拐角处。

transcript.en: It was great to meet you last week at the conference.
transcript.zh: 上周在会议上认识你真是太高兴了。

transcript.en: I really enjoyed our conversation about foreign investment.
transcript.zh: 我真的很享受我们关于外国投资的讨论。

transcript.en: Yeah, yeah, it was really interesting.
transcript.zh: 是啊是啊，确实很有意思。

transcript.en: You know, I'm in a bit of a hurry, but here's my card.
transcript.zh: 是这样，我有点赶时间，不过这是我的名片。

transcript.en: We should definitely meet up again and continue our discussion.
transcript.zh: 我们一定要找时间再聚聚，继续我们的讨论。

transcript.en: Sure, you still have my contact details, right?
transcript.zh: 当然，你还有我的联系方式，对吧？

transcript.en: You know what, this is really embarrassing, but your name has just slipped my mind.
transcript.zh: 说来挺尴尬的，但我突然想不起你的名字了。

transcript.en: Sure, my name is Ana Ferris.
Don't worry about it, it happens to me all the time.
transcript.zh: 别担心，这种事经常发生在我身上。

transcript.en: You can understand a lot better, right?
transcript.zh: 你能理解得更好了，对吧？

transcript.en: Now, it's time for us to take a look at Fluency Builder.
transcript.zh: 现在，我们来看看「流利表达」。

transcript.en: So with Fluency Builder, we take some very simple phrases and show you how you can be more fluent or how you can...
transcript.zh: 在流利表达环节，我们选取一些非常简单的短语，向你展示如何更流利或者如何……

transcript.en: In the beginning of the dialogue, Anna said, Nick, how's it going?
transcript.zh: 在对话的开头，安娜说，Nick, how's it going?

transcript.en: Yeah, this is a great phrase.
transcript.zh: 是啊，这是一个很棒的短语。

transcript.en: You know, sometimes I hear students say, how are you?
transcript.zh: 你知道，有时我听到学生说 how are you?
或者 how are you doing?

transcript.en: Those are two great phrases, but this one sounds really, really natural.
transcript.zh: 这两个短语也很棒，但这个听起来非常非常自然。

transcript.en: Yeah, let's listen again to that phrase from the dialogue.
transcript.zh: 是的，我们再听一遍对话中的那个短语。

transcript.en: So next time that you find a friend on the street, you can just say, hey, how's it going?
transcript.zh: 所以下次你在街上遇到朋友，你可以直接说，嘿，how's it going?

transcript.en: So Marco, have you ever forgotten someone's name?
transcript.zh: 那么马可，你有没有忘记过某人的名字？

transcript.en: Yeah, it's happened to me a couple of times.
And actually, the most embarrassing situation was that I forgot a family member's name.
transcript.zh: 而且实际上，最尴尬的情况是我忘了一个家人的名字。

transcript.en: We had like a family reunion and there were a lot of aunts and uncles and cousins that I hadn't seen in a while.
transcript.zh: 我们有一个家庭聚会，有很多阿姨、叔叔和表兄弟姐妹，我好久没见了。

transcript.en: And I just forgot one of my uncle's names.
transcript.zh: 然后我就忘了我其中一个叔叔的名字。

transcript.en: Well, I had to ask one of my other cousins.
transcript.zh: 嗯，我只好问另一个表兄弟。

transcript.en: I'm like, hey, who is that guy?
He's like, oh, that's Uncle John.
I'm like, oh man, I totally forgot.
transcript.zh: 我说，哦天哪，我完全忘了。

transcript.en: So it was really embarrassing because I didn't know what to call him.
transcript.zh: 所以真的很尴尬，因为我不知道该怎么叫他。

transcript.en: So I just called him Uncle because I didn't know his name.
transcript.zh: 所以我只叫他叔叔，因为我不知道他的名字。

transcript.en: So when that happens to me, when I'm in a business setting, sometimes what I do is I ask for someone's card.
transcript.zh: 所以当那种情况发生在我身上时，在商务场合，有时我会做的是要对方的名片。

transcript.en: Or sometimes I might ask them to write down their email because usually their full name is spelled in their email address.
transcript.zh: 或者有时我会请他们写下邮箱地址，因为通常他们的全名会拼在邮箱地址里。

transcript.en: So that's my trick when I've forgotten someone's name.
transcript.zh: 所以这就是我忘记某人名字时的小技巧。

transcript.en: And I guess a lot of our listeners can take your advice on that.
transcript.zh: 我想我们很多听众可以采纳你的建议。

transcript.en: So I think it's time for us to listen to our dialogue one more time, this time at natural speed.
transcript.zh: 那么我想我们该再听一遍对话了，这次是自然语速。

transcript.en: What are you doing in this neighbourhood?
Actually, my office is right around the corner.
transcript.zh: 其实，我的办公室就在拐角处。

transcript.en: It was great to meet you last week at the conference.
transcript.zh: 上周在会议上认识你真是太高兴了。

transcript.en: I really enjoyed our conversation about foreign investment.
transcript.zh: 我真的很享受我们关于外国投资的讨论。

transcript.en: Yeah, yeah, it was really interesting.
transcript.zh: 是啊是啊，确实很有意思。

transcript.en: You know, I'm in a bit of a hurry, but here's my card.
transcript.zh: 是这样，我有点赶时间，不过这是我的名片。

transcript.en: We should definitely meet up again and continue our discussion.
transcript.zh: 我们一定要找时间再聚聚，继续我们的讨论。

transcript.en: Sure, you still have my contact details, right?
transcript.zh: 当然，你还有我的联系方式，对吧？

transcript.en: You know what, this is really embarrassing, but your name has just slipped my mind.
transcript.zh: 说来挺尴尬的，但我突然想不起你的名字了。

transcript.en: Sure, my name is Ana Ferris.
Don't worry about it, it happens to me all the time.
transcript.zh: 别担心，这种事经常发生在我身上。

transcript.en: Well, I hope that you've all enjoyed our lesson for today, and remember to check out our website at EnglishPod.com.
transcript.zh: 嗯，希望大家喜欢今天的课程，记得访问我们的网站 EnglishPod.com。

transcript.en: Where you can find a lot of other resources and you can leave all your questions and comments.
transcript.zh: 在那里你可以找到很多其他资源，也可以留下你所有的问题和评论。

transcript.en: Marco and I are always on the site, so we're happy to answer all of your questions.
transcript.zh: 马可和我一直都在网站上，我们很乐意回答你所有的问题。

transcript.en: So now it's time for us to say...
